nativeTemporalInstant.gate: Host Temporal.Instant unavailable; seven structured-clone checks and four native import/export checks

cases.title: readFile on a directory is blamed on read, which names no path
cases.reason: memfs blames the open rather than the read and names the path node omits

cases.title: rm of a file in a write-denied directory is blamed on unlink
cases.reason: memfs blames rm, the fs function, where node blames the unlink it refused

cases.title: copyFile with COPYFILE_EXCL onto an existing path is blamed on copyfile
cases.reason: memfs blames copyFile, the fs function, where node blames the lower-cased syscall

cases.title: utimes on a missing path is blamed on utime
cases.reason: memfs blames utimes, the fs function, where node blames the utime syscall

cases.title: mkdir recursive returns the first directory it created
cases.reason: memfs returns the requested path rather than the first directory created

cases.title: mkdir recursive returns the first directory created below an existing parent
cases.reason: memfs returns the requested path rather than the first directory created

cases.title: mkdir recursive returns the first directory it created as the path was spelled
cases.reason: memfs returns the requested path rather than the first directory created

cases.title: mkdir non-recursive with a missing parent rejects with ENOENT
cases.reason: memfs blames the missing parent rather than the path mkdir was given

cases.title: mkdir non-recursive through a file segment rejects with ENOTDIR
cases.reason: memfs blames the file segment rather than the path mkdir was given

cases.title: mkdir recursive on an existing file rejects with EEXIST
cases.reason: memfs forgives an existing file when mkdir is recursive and resolves

cases.title: rm on a missing path without force rejects with ENOENT
cases.reason: memfs blames stat where node's rm lstats the path first

cases.title: rm force through a file segment still rejects with ENOTDIR
cases.reason: memfs blames stat where node's rm lstats the path first

cases.title: rm on a directory without recursive rejects with ERR_FS_EISDIR
cases.reason: memfs raises a plain Error and prefixes the code to node's message

cases.title: rm force on a directory without recursive still rejects with ERR_FS_EISDIR
cases.reason: memfs raises a plain Error and prefixes the code to node's message

cases.title: rm on a symlink to a directory unlinks the link
cases.reason: memfs follows the link and refuses it as a directory instead of unlinking it

cases.title: rm on a dangling symlink without force unlinks the link
cases.reason: memfs stats through the link and reports the missing target as ENOENT

cases.title: appendFile with flag r rejects with EBADF
cases.reason: memfs ignores the read-only flag and appends where node refuses the write

cases.title: readFile through a symlink to a directory rejects with EISDIR
cases.reason: memfs blames open with the directory the link resolved to where node blames a pathless read

cases.title: readFile through a symlink loop rejects with ELOOP
cases.reason: memfs recurses through the cycle instead of answering ELOOP

cases.title: stat through a symlink loop rejects with ELOOP
cases.reason: memfs recurses through the cycle instead of answering ELOOP

cases.title: realpath through a symlink loop rejects with ELOOP
cases.reason: memfs recurses through the cycle instead of answering ELOOP

cases.title: copyFile with COPYFILE_EXCL onto an existing destination rejects with EEXIST
cases.reason: memfs names the copyFile function where node names the copyfile syscall

cases.title: copyFile onto itself with COPYFILE_EXCL rejects with EEXIST
cases.reason: memfs names the copyFile function where node names the copyfile syscall

cases.title: copyFile where the source is a directory rejects with darwin's own code
cases.reason: memfs opens the source and refuses it as EISDIR where darwin's copyfile answers ENOTSUP

cases.title: copyFile where the destination is a directory rejects with EISDIR
cases.reason: memfs blames the destination it opened where node blames the source and reports the destination as dest

cases.title: cp non-recursive on a directory rejects with ERR_FS_EISDIR
cases.reason: memfs raises a plain EISDIR where node raises its own ERR_FS_EISDIR

cases.title: cp with errorOnExist and force off onto an existing file rejects with ERR_FS_CP_EEXIST
cases.reason: memfs raises a plain EEXIST where node raises its own ERR_FS_CP_EEXIST

cases.title: cp of a directory into itself rejects with ERR_FS_CP_EINVAL
cases.reason: memfs raises a plain EINVAL blaming the source where node raises ERR_FS_CP_EINVAL blaming the destination

cases.title: rename of a file onto an existing directory rejects with EISDIR
cases.reason: memfs replaces the directory with the file instead of refusing it as EISDIR

cases.title: rename of a directory onto an existing file rejects with ENOTDIR
cases.reason: memfs replaces the file with the directory instead of refusing it as ENOTDIR

cases.title: rename of a directory onto a non-empty directory rejects with ENOTEMPTY
cases.reason: memfs overwrites the non-empty directory instead of refusing it as ENOTEMPTY

cases.title: link where the source is a directory rejects with EPERM
cases.reason: memfs hard-links the directory instead of refusing it as EPERM

cases.title: writeFile into a missing directory rejects with ENOENT
cases.reason: memfs blames the missing parent rather than the path it was given, and names no syscall in the message at all

disposition: All remain skips/nonpasses. Host capability absence and memfs reference gaps are not guest ECMAScript defects.
